beats.say: This eighty kilometer ditch saves ships almost thirteen thousand kilometers.
beats.title: 82 KM THAT SAVE 12,600 KM

beats.say: Without it, a ship from New York to San Francisco has to sail all the way around South America.
With the canal, it cuts straight through Panama. Twelve thousand six hundred kilometers shorter.

big.label: saved, New York to San Francisco

beats.say: Ships don't sail through flat water. Locks lift them twenty six meters, up to a lake, then back down.
Every ship uses around two hundred million liters of fresh water from that lake. In the twenty twenty three drought, the canal had to cut traffic.
About five percent of all sea trade on Earth squeezes through here.
Eighty kilometers of water holding up world trade. Follow for more.
beats.title: THE DITCH THAT RUNS THE WORLD
